paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity of different blocks in a model, specifically DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, under two quantization schemes: 4-Bit (blue bars) and 2-Bit (green bars), as a function of Block Index ranging from 0 to 63. The vertical axis, labeled "Sensitivity," is on a logarithmic scale spanning from 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻⁴, with tick marks at regular intervals. The horizontal axis, labeled "Block Index," displays integer values from 0 to 63, with major tick marks at 0, 15, 31, 47, and 63. For each block index, two adjacent bars are shown: the blue bar represents the 4-Bit quantization sensitivity, and the green bar represents the 2-Bit quantization sensitivity. The bars are arranged in ascending order of Block Index from left to right. The green bars (2-Bit) generally exhibit lower sensitivity values, mostly clustered between 10⁻⁵ and slightly above, with some minor fluctuations. In contrast, the blue bars (4-Bit) show higher sensitivity, particularly in the later blocks (indices 47 to 63), where they rise significantly above 10⁻⁵, reaching close to 10⁻⁴ in several cases. The chart visually highlights that 4-Bit quantization tends to have higher sensitivity than 2-Bit, especially in the latter half of the block sequence. There is no explicit sorting or emphasis on specific bars, and all bars are uniformly styled without additional annotations or shading.
